component.name: osv360
component.summary: Convert DJI Osmo 360 .OSV files into stabilized equirectangular video

description.p: osv360 stitches the two fisheye lenses of the DJI Osmo 360 using the camera's own calibration, locks the horizon with the built-in 1 kHz IMU and writes standard 8K HEVC 10-bit 360° video that Kdenlive, FilmCraft and other editors can open. Stitching runs on the GPU (Vulkan), decoding and encoding use VA-API.
